unverified_statements.text: The schedule for the loads (when and how often the run procedure runs).
unverified_statements.reason: ADR-001 says only that a person schedules the run procedure after the Phase 1 run once MOD-016 delivers it. No artefact gives a time or frequency, so the runbook says it is still to be confirmed.

unverified_statements.text: Whether Subs.vwCorpSubscriptions holds real rows with a missing Contact No, Scheme No or Sub Campaign Year.
unverified_statements.reason: The external catalogue lists these columns as nullable, and any such row would stop the corporate subscription load (answers 2026-10-26). No profiling result shows whether such rows exist, so the pack says only what the load does if one appears.

unverified_statements.text: Whether two source rows whose contact or scheme numbers differ only in letter case or trailing spaces count as the same key.
unverified_statements.reason: This is my own reasoning, not a recorded result. CN-MOD-004 says a change only in case or trailing spaces in a key column updates the existing row in place, so two such rows in one source snapshot may be treated as a repeated key and fail the load. No test or artefact covers this, so it is not in the pack.

unverified_statements.text: How Q-033 is to be settled (which profiling query, or which source owner confirms it).
unverified_statements.reason: The cut-off DES-001 entry for Q-033 shows only the question. The pack asks the client to confirm it but names no route for settling it.
